counterfactual.change: changed actuated from true to false, which makes yellow last full yellow_seconds and removes violation, proving actuated logic causes early yellow termination

explanation: Actuated mode terminates NS yellow after only 1s instead of required 3s. With actuated=true, NS green -> NS yellow at step 325 -> all-red at 326, giving 1s yellow. With actuated=false the same traffic pattern respects yellow duration. Likely the controller's demand/recall logic that ends green early is also applied to yellow phase, or it forces transition to all-red/EW green when EW has waited, ignoring yellow_seconds minimum. Fix should enforce yellow_seconds even when actuated early termination/recall is active.
vision_note: In step 324 two approaches show green, in 325 the same approaches turn yellow, and by step 326 all four approaches are already red. The yellow phase lasts only one second before the all-red clearance, which is shorter than the required 3s.
